name: Chimestick
description: Send the lowest blade skimming at ankle height so the foe must lift a foot or take the cut.

name: Ravaging Edgeflat
description: Throw the middle blade level with the belt so it forces a guard to drop to the hips.

name: Furrowing Thunk
description: Flick the top blade at the collar line so the foe's chin lifts and the throat shows.

name: Mightshiv
description: Roll the empty fingers closed and reload the fan from the sleeve in one smooth turn of the wrist.

name: Gust Spinthrow
description: Throw blades in three heights with a qi pulse each so they strike ankle belt and collar in order.

name: Thunkcloak
description: Show a low throw then switch the real fan to the high layer so the foe's guard drops wrongly.

name: Thunktorment
description: Throw a dense fan from boots to brow in one burst so no dodge leaves the whole body clear.

name: Thornlean
description: Gather qi into a heavy fan that pins cloak sleeve and boot to the ground in one drive.

name: Nova Flickthrow
description: Throw a knife with a short cord looped on the pommel so it can be hauled back after the cast.

name: Daybreak Pointguard
description: Wind the cord's end twice round the wrist so a hard throw cannot pull it from the hand.

name: Thunkhauberk
description: Haul the cord sharply after the blade lodges to tear a hooked strap or branch from its place.

name: Granite Throwgrip
description: Carry the spare coil over the forearm while stepping so no loop catches a heel.

name: Rumble Spinetip
description: Whip the cord outward as the knife leaves so the blade swings round a post to strike behind it.

name: Hoarfrost Weighttang
description: Throw over a beam and haul the cord so a foe's wrist is jerked up and held there.

name: Leanremedy
description: Snap the cord back with a pulse of qi so the lodged blade comes free and flies to the hand.

name: Staggering Bladeflat
description: Cast two corded blades in a crossing path so the lines knot round a foe's arms and chest.

name: Thorn Spineweight
description: Stretch corded blades across a doorway so a foe who pushes through trips into a bind.

name: Daybreak Balanceblade
description: Spread the fingers and let the qi field settle round the hand before the first throw.

name: Chimeshiv
description: Read the blade's balance through the field and adjust the grip by a finger's width.

name: Scalding Flight
description: Throw with the field wrapped round the blade so it flies dead straight past its usual range.

name: Enduring Throwtang
description: Thicken the field at the shoulder to turn aside a glancing blow without moving the feet.

name: Torrent Throwtang
description: Slide one pace along the line of the field's edge to keep the foe at the thrown range.

name: Chime Weighttang
description: Bend the blade's path with a light pull of the field so it curves round a raised arm.

name: Rupturing Stick
description: Hold a lane of guided blades across a corridor so the foe cannot cross it without cuts.

name: Daybreak Hiltweight
description: Pull spent blades back toward the hand through the field so the next volley begins at once.

name: Raging Dismantling
description: Gather the field then send a falling sheet of guided blades across the whole front.

name: Blaze Spinthrow
description: Mark a target with the field and throw so the blade follows its dodges to the last step.

name: Facet Spineweight
description: Throw with the shoulder held perfectly still so only the wrist and fingers betray the cast.

name: Facet Edgeflat
description: Draw a blade from a coat pocket and throw it before the hand has cleared the cloth.

name: Glint Balanceblade
description: Flick a blade out of a loose cuff with a turn of the hand that looks like a wave.

name: Mayhemstick
description: Hold the foe's eyes steady while the free hand makes the throw below their line of sight.

name: Torrent Flight
description: Set each foot down toe-first so no sound or dust signals the thrower's change of stance.

name: Hiltweight Cloak
description: Let the cloak swing across the arm to mask the throw and catch a thrown dart.

name: Drubbing Throwgrip
description: Release with no pull of the arm and a short qi pulse so the blade punches deep unseen.

name: Lodgehauberk
description: Hold the blade ready until the foe moves then throw into the very step the foe commits.

name: Facet Stick
description: Hide a second blade behind the first one's flight so the foe parries once and is struck by the other.

name: Iron Spinetip
description: Throw the one blade with no tell and all qi aimed so it pierces a guard before it is seen.

name: Shadeshiv
description: Draw and loose a sequence of unseen blades so the foe cannot tell which hand throws.

name: Glint Thunk
description: Throw from the left hand in the formal court style with the right hand held ready behind.

name: Glint Bladeflat
description: Throw from the right hand in the formal court style with the left hand curled at the chest.

name: Wrecking Pointguard
description: Stand with both hands level and release both knives at once at two marks a hand apart.

name: Remnant Bladeflat
description: Read both of the foe's hands in one glance and decide which paired throw answers them.

name: Flickthrow Spurt
description: Take a short step on the same side as the leading hand to open the line for the second knife.

name: Balanceblade Cloak
description: Cross the wrists and knock a cut aside with one blade while the other is ready to throw.

name: Grinding Throwgrip
description: Throw one blade high and let a qi echo of the cast send a second low an instant later.

name: Granite Spineweight
description: Cross feet in a running river step while the hands loose blades in turn on either side.

name: Resilient Pointguard
description: Throw one blade into an incoming cut to deflect it while the second answers at once.

name: Gyve Lodge
description: Pin a foe's sleeve with the left knife and press the right knife at the throat to hold still.

name: Nova Weighttang
description: Throw two blades on arcs that meet at one point on the foe so a single guard cannot stop both.

name: Leanhauberk
description: Cast blades from both hands to lodge in a crossing lattice that blocks a corridor with cut lines.

name: Intent Throwtang
description: Hold the blade high with the elbow lifted like a hawk perched ready to drop on prey.

name: Hoarfrost Stick
description: Throw steeply downward from a raised position so the blade plunges onto a foe below.

name: Blaze Thunk
description: Flick a second blade upward from below so it meets the diving first blade at the target.

name: Mightlodge
description: Land from a drop on both feet with a short bounce so the throw and the landing are one.

name: Shivthrash
description: Dive the first blade at the head and the second at the feet so both meet at the target's center.

name: Leanplating
description: Throw an empty hand upward as a feint so the foe's eyes lift before the true low blade lands.

name: Quelling Lodge
description: Pin a foe's weapon hand against the post with a downward plunging throw through the glove.

name: Harrowing Hiltweight
description: Plunge a qi-edged blade from above with a second rising beneath so one hit follows the other.

name: Severing Edgeflat
description: Ride a spiral of qi round the foe with blades that dive in turn and rise again to the hand.

name: Torrent Spinetip
description: Hold the left hand in a guard line while the right hand stays ready to throw.

name: Leantorment
description: Keep the right hand on a straight throwing line while the left covers the chest.

name: Equipoise Pointguard
description: Pass the knife from one hand to the other so the two tracks of guard and cast trade roles.

name: Torrent Weighttang
description: Sweep both hands across the body so the guarding knife cuts a stray blade off its path.

name: Might Flight
description: Move in small level steps like water settling so the upper body stays steady for both tracks.

name: Spinthrow Torment
description: Turn the shoulder to cover while the far hand throws so cast and guard are done in one turn.

name: Waning Throwgrip
description: Knock a thrown dart from the air with the guard hand and fling it back with the other.

name: Paralyzing Lodge
description: Send a qi pulse down each arm to break a foe's wrist grip while the throw is still held.

name: Shivbarrage
description: Chain guard and cast on alternating tracks so every blow received is met by a thrown answer.

name: Guststick
description: Throw along the axis of the guard arm so the knife leaves while the cover is never lowered.

name: Keen Spinetip
description: Read cloud shadow and grass lean over the plateau to tell what the air will do to the blade.

name: Rumble Throwtang
description: Lean the body into the wind and throw so the blade rides the current and not against it.

name: Chime Spineweight
description: Plant on the plateau rim and throw the full length of the span in one long clean pull.

name: Silt Bladeflat
description: Set the feet in a wide stance on bare stone and settle the weight before each throw.

name: Spinthrow Assault
description: Wait for a gust and throw high so the wind sets the blade down on a distant mark.

name: Blaze Edgeflat
description: Skip a blade off a rock face so the wind bends its path into a foe who thinks he is covered.

name: Facetlean
description: Throw at the extreme range of the plateau with a bearing held so the blade lands exactly where sworn.

name: Ponderous Thunk
description: Throw a volley that bends with a crosswind so each blade corrects itself and all converge at the mark.

name: Silt Flight
description: Stand on both feet as if rooted to the oath stone and let the throw come from the planted legs.

name: Hiltweight Thrash
description: Throw at full force from the lip of a cliff where a missed step is not allowed.

name: Rumble Balanceblade
description: Run along the rim and throw at the stride's end without breaking pace or looking down.

name: Ravaging Spinthrow
description: Draw a blade in the same motion as speaking the oath word and throw before the word ends.

name: Blaze Balanceblade
description: Dig the heel into scree so the leg takes the recoil and the knife leaves with the whole body.

name: Mightslim
description: Step crosswise down loose slope in sliding paces that keep the throwing arm level.

name: Silencing Thunk
description: Throw into a foe's cloak at the rim so the pinned cloth holds him from the drop beyond.

name: Stickassault
description: Throw rim to rim in rapid turns across the gap so the foe dares not leave cover.

name: Gustshiv
description: Cast a blade into an incoming throw sworn to meet it so both fall short of the oath-taker.

name: Silt Pointguard
description: Throw a spread of blades across the open ground in the oath's name so none may cross unharmed.

name: Stick Plating
description: Fix a blade into the foe's shadow-cast ground with qi so the foe cannot step beyond it.

name: Waningslim
description: Lock the eyes along one bearing line to the target and keep it through the whole cast.

name: Facet Hiltweight
description: Brace the shoulder against a strong gust and throw on the bearing without drifting off it.

name: Might Weighttang
description: Slide the feet while the hips stay turned to the mark so the bearing never moves.

name: Rumble Edgeflat
description: Flick the blade along the held bearing with a loose wrist so no tension bends the line.

name: Flickthrow Maelstrom
description: Throw into a gale head-on with a steeper angle and heavy shoulder to keep the blade low.

name: Unmaking Spineweight
description: Hold the bearing with a thread of qi so the blade does not turn off line in rough air.

name: Leanthrash
description: Throw from a pitching platform by timing the release to the roll and keeping the bearing fixed.

name: Resilient Bladeflat
description: Shift the footing to take a cut off line and answer with a throw held on the old bearing.

name: Stick Torment
description: Pour all qi into one throw on a sworn bearing so it pierces both guard and the armor behind.

name: Silt Spinetip
description: Cast blades on a bearing so a wind-laid lane of steel holds any who cross it.
